appDesc.message: Authenticator - generate secure codes in your browser. Fast, offline two-factor authentication for all your accounts.

storeDesc.message:
Authenticator: Your Secure Two-Factor Authentication for Chrome
Protect your online accounts with Authenticator — the ultimate two-factor authentication extension built directly into your Chrome browser. Generate secure TOTP and HOTP codes instantly, without switching devices. Authenticator makes two-factor authentication simple, fast, and reliable for everyone.

🔐 What Authenticator Offers:
🛡️ Effortless Two-Factor Authentication
⚡ Enable Authenticator protection for all your accounts in seconds
⚡ Generate one-time passcodes (OTP) with a single click using Authenticator
⚡ Support for TOTP and HOTP protocols — the gold standard of two-factor authentication
⚡ Never worry about losing access to your Authenticator codes again

🔑 Secure Code Generation with Authenticator
🔒 Generate time-based one-time passwords (TOTP) directly in Chrome
🔒 Authenticator supports all major platforms: 2FA, Facebook, Amazon, GitHub, Dropbox, and more
🔒 Each Authenticator code refreshes automatically every 30 seconds
🔒 Your two-factor authentication codes are always accurate and perfectly synced

⚡ Lightning-Fast Authenticator Access
🚀 Open Authenticator from the browser toolbar — instant access to all your codes
🚀 No need to reach for your phone — two-factor authentication is now in your browser
🚀 Copy your Authenticator code with one click and paste it into any login form
🚀 Save precious time every day with Authenticator's streamlined workflow

🔍 Easy QR Code Scanning
📷 Add new accounts to Authenticator by scanning QR codes
📷 Use your webcam or upload a screenshot — Authenticator handles both
📷 Set up two-factor authentication for a new service in under 10 seconds
📷 Authenticator automatically detects and parses QR codes for seamless setup

🛡️ Privacy-First Authenticator Security
🔐 All Authenticator data is stored locally on your device
🔐 Your two-factor authentication secrets never leave your browser
🔐 No external servers, no cloud storage — Authenticator keeps everything offline
🔐 Full encryption ensures your Authenticator keys remain private and protected

📦 Backup & Restore Your Authenticator Data
💾 Export your Authenticator accounts securely for backup
💾 Restore your two-factor authentication data when switching devices or browsers
💾 Never lose access to your Authenticator codes — backup with confidence
💾 Authenticator makes migration between devices simple and safe

🌐 Universal Authenticator Compatibility
🌍 Authenticator works with thousands of websites and services
🌍 Compatible with any platform that supports TOTP-based two-factor authentication
🌍 Use Authenticator with 2FA, Microsoft, Twitter, LinkedIn, Binance, Coinbase, and more
🌍 Replace 2FA Authenticator, Authy, or any other app — all inside Chrome

🎨 Clean, Intuitive Authenticator Interface
✨ Authenticator features a modern, user-friendly design
✨ Organize your two-factor authentication accounts with custom labels and icons
✨ Search through your Authenticator codes instantly — even with hundreds of accounts
✨ Dark mode and light mode support — Authenticator adapts to your preferences

🚀 How to Start with Authenticator:
📥 Step 1: Install Authenticator from the Chrome Web Store
📥 Step 2: Click the Authenticator icon in your browser toolbar
📥 Step 3: Add your first account by scanning a QR code or entering a secret key manually
📥 Step 4: Use your Authenticator codes instantly — two-factor authentication is now at your fingertips

Setting up two-factor authentication has never been easier. Authenticator guides you through every step, so even if you're new to authentication, you'll be protected in minutes. 💡 Why Choose 2FA Authenticator?
⭐ Instant 2FA Authenticator codes — no phone required, two-factor authentication lives in your browser
⭐ Offline functionality — 2FA Authenticator generates codes without an internet connection
⭐ Top-tier security — your two-factor authentication secrets are encrypted and stored locally
⭐ Universal compatibility — 2FA Authenticator supports every TOTP-enabled service
⭐ Zero cost — powerful two-factor authentication completely free
⭐ Lightweight & fast — 2FA Authenticator uses minimal resources and never slows down Chrome
⭐ No account required — start using 2FA Authenticator immediately, no sign-up needed
⭐ Regular updates — 2FA Authenticator is constantly improved for better security and performance

🔐 Why Two-Factor Authentication Matters:
In today's digital world, passwords alone are not enough. Two-factor authentication (2FA Authenticator) adds a critical second layer of security to your accounts. With 2FA Authenticator, you generate a unique, time-sensitive code that must be entered alongside your password. Even if someone steals your password, they cannot access your account without the 2FA Authenticator code from your authenticator.

2FA Authenticator brings the power of two-factor authentication directly into Chrome, eliminating the need to carry a separate device or install a mobile 2FA Authenticator app. Whether you're securing your email, social media, banking, cryptocurrency wallets, or work accounts, 2FA Authenticator provides robust two-factor authentication protection for everything.

🏆 2FA Authenticator vs. Other Authenticator Apps:
Unlike mobile-based 2FA Authenticator apps, 2FA Authenticator lives right where you need it — in your browser. No more switching between your phone and computer. No more typing codes manually. With 2FA Authenticator, your two-factor authentication codes are just one click away.

Compared to other browser-based authenticator extensions, 2FA Authenticator stands out with its focus on security, speed, and simplicity. Every aspect of 2FA Authenticator is designed to make two-factor authentication as seamless as possible while keeping your data fully protected.

🔧 Advanced 2FA Authenticator Features:
🛠️ Support for SHA-1, SHA-256, and SHA-512 algorithms in 2FA Authenticator code generation
🛠️ Customizable code refresh intervals for advanced two-factor authentication setups
🛠️ Manual entry of secret keys for services that don't provide QR codes
🛠️ 2FA Authenticator supports 6-digit and 8-digit OTP codes
🛠️ Bulk import and export for managing large numbers of 2FA Authenticator accounts
🛠️ Counter-based HOTP support alongside standard TOTP two-factor authentication

📢 Trusted by Thousands of Users Worldwide
2FA Authenticator is trusted by security-conscious individuals, developers, IT professionals, and everyday users who understand the importance of two-factor authentication. Join the growing community of users who rely on 2FA Authenticator to keep their digital lives secure.

Your security matters. Your time matters. 2FA Authenticator delivers both — powerful two-factor authentication with zero friction, zero cost, and zero compromise. Install 2FA Authenticator today and take control of your online security with the most convenient two-factor authentication solution for Chrome.

🔐 2FA Authenticator — Two-Factor Authentication Made Simple, Secure, and Smart.
